name: pr-dashboard
description: Your open GitHub pull requests in a pane beside the chat, and an MCP server Claude can ask about them.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Personal access token with read access to your pull requests. Leave empty to use GH_TOKEN or your gh CLI login.

github_host.title: GitHub host
github_host.description: Your GitHub Enterprise Server host, such as github.example.com. Leave empty for github.com.

watched_repos.title: Repositories
watched_repos.description: owner/repo, separated by commas. Leave empty to show pull requests from every repository.

open_on_start.title: Open on start
open_on_start.description: Open the pane when a session starts.

summary_bar.title: Summary bar
summary_bar.description: Show a one-line pull request summary above the prompt box.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notify you when a pull request needs your review, is returned to you, or is ready to merge.

ai_summaries.title: AI summaries
ai_summaries.description: Write a one-line summary under each pull request with the smallest Claude model (Haiku). Summaries are kept until the pull request changes.
